cluster_009fe542c789_188283f195d5.headline: Blackstone's BXDC Data Center REIT Raises $1.75B in NYSE IPO
cluster_009fe542c789_188283f195d5.summary: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust (BXDC) completed its NYSE IPO on May 14, raising $1.75 billion by selling 87.5 million shares at $20 per share, with underwriters holding a 30-day option to increase total proceeds to $2 billion. The REIT, structured as a 'blind pool' with no assets yet acquired, will target newly constructed, stabilized data centers valued between $250 million and $1.5 billion, occupied by investment-grade hyperscale tenants on long-term leases at yields of 5.75% to 7%. Blackstone has identified approximately $25 billion in potential near-term acquisitions in Northern Virginia, Ohio, Phoenix, Maryland, and Austin. Nick Pell, former president and CIO of Blackstone's Link Logistics industrial REIT, was named CEO of the new entity.

cluster_7bc83cd4c0f8_e712eb8b2d13.headline: US Industrial Production Surges 0.7% in April, Strongest Gain in 14 Months
cluster_7bc83cd4c0f8_e712eb8b2d13.summary: U.S. industrial production rose 0.7% in April 2026, the largest monthly gain in 14 months, according to the Federal Reserve's G.17 report released May 15. The result significantly exceeded the consensus estimate of 0.3%, following a March decline of 0.5% attributed to the Iran war's impact on factory and utility output. Manufacturing output, which comprises approximately 78% of total industrial production, climbed 0.6%, beating forecasts of 0.2%, while utilities output jumped 1.9% and mining output edged down 0.1%. Capacity utilization rose to 76.1%, remaining 3.3 percentage points below its long-run average.

cluster_e16c7704eeed_f2bb4ff27cfe.headline: Trump and Xi Agree on Strategic Framework, Boeing Deal After Beijing Summit
cluster_e16c7704eeed_f2bb4ff27cfe.summary: President Trump concluded a two-day summit with President Xi Jinping in Beijing on May 15, with China agreeing to purchase U.S. oil and 200 Boeing aircraft. The two leaders established a 'strategic stability' framework to govern the bilateral relationship for three years, and Trump invited Xi to the White House for a visit on September 24. The existing one-year trade truce set in October 2025 remains in place, with average U.S. tariffs on Chinese goods currently at 47.5%, while that status quo is set to expire in November. Analysts noted that major sticking points on trade, semiconductors, and AI remained unresolved despite positive optics from the summit.
